cohort: 15,551 non-Asian women without pregravid diabetes or hypertension who delivered singleton babies between 2002 and 2010
finding: GDM was the main contributor to caesarean section and preeclampsia, while prepregnancy weight and GWG primarily influenced the risk of LGA and SGA infants in women without GDM.
mod_finding: This study found that while gestational diabetes was the main contributor to cesarean section and preeclampsia, pre-pregnancy overweight/obesity and gestational weight gain were associated with large and small for gestational age infants, primarily in women without gestational diabetes.
